requirements.text: Enhance customer experience to compete with fintechs.
Implement real-time transaction notifications that include transaction details and remaining balances.
Support biometric authentication methods such as fingerprint and facial recognition for secure logins.
Provide budgeting tools, including automated spending breakdowns and personalized budget alerts.
Make lending options available within the app for customers to apply for loans or credit limit changes.
Ensure compliance with PSD2 and GDPR regulations.
Integrate smoothly with the legacy core banking system without requiring major changes.
Each notification must include the transaction amount, merchant name, and customer's remaining balance immediately after the transaction.
Notifications should be presented in a concise and visually appealing format, including both push notifications and an in-app notification center.
Customers should have the option to customize notifications based on transaction amounts or specific categories for enhanced personalization.
Notifications should be processed and delivered within five seconds of the transaction completion.
Support both fingerprint and facial recognition as primary methods for login.
Prompt users to set up biometric authentication during the onboarding process.
Use biometric authentication for sensitive actions within the app, such as approving transactions and accessing detailed account information.
Provide alternative login options, such as traditional passwords or PINs, for users who prefer not to use biometric methods.
Store biometric data securely and ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR.
Provide automated monthly spending breakdowns categorised by merchant type with visual aids like pie charts or bar graphs.
Allow customers to set personalized monthly budgets for each spending category.
Implement alerts to notify users when they are approaching or exceeding set budgets.
Offer tips or insights on adjusting spending or saving more based on budget performance.
Integrate budgeting tools with real-time transaction notifications for immediate alerts if a transaction pushes users over their budget.
Present clear options for different types of lending products with straightforward terms and conditions.
Provide a seamless and guided application process for lending products within the app.
Implement a pre-approval feature for customers to see if they qualify for a loan or credit increase before formally applying.
Keep customers informed with real-time updates on the status of their lending applications.
Ensure compliance with responsible lending practices and affordability assessments.
Allow customers to manage their repayments easily within the app, including setting up automatic repayments and viewing repayment schedules.
Provide reminders before repayments are due.
